quests.title: Versus Yasuhiko Tarou

dialogue.t: I greatly look forward to this duel. I wonder what the extent of your skills is.

dialogue.sit: Uh, what are you doing here...

dialogue.t: Actually, when I said previously that 4 warriors had joined, I was including myself in that list.
I'm the organizer, yes, but there were just too few participants...
And anyway, I was born for combat! Since there is a mighty foe before me, I must have my duel!
...Hehe, I've been waiting to say that for a long time now!
Uh, Paimon's not sure this person is right in the head.

dialogue.sit: Best not to underestimate him all the same.

dialogue.t: Exactly! Your desire to show no partiality to your foes fills me with respect for you!
Previously, if I had not looked down on our fourth contestant, I would not have suffered such a terrible defeat.
But the man I am today is not the man I was yesterday! Come on then, {NICKNAME}, let us duel!

dialogue.sit: Give me a second to prepare.

quests.description: Claiming that he was “born for combat,” and with his head full of strange thoughts, Yasuhiko Tarou seeks a duel with you at last.
